slides.title: Which standard does it support?
slides.body: SAML or OpenID Connect, and does it work with our identity provider?

slides.title: Is SSO on the plan we're buying?
slides.body: Plenty of vendors keep it for pricier plans. Ask before you sign.

slides.title: Does it support SCIM?
slides.body: Without it, accounts inside the app get created and removed by hand, even after sign-in's blocked.

slides.title: Can we turn off password login?
slides.body: If staff can still sign in with a password, someone who has left may still have a way back in.

slides.title: When someone leaves
slides.body: Disable their account in the identity provider and revoke their active sessions in the same step.

slides.title: At each offboarding review
slides.body: List which apps require the company login, which allow a password and which accounts are removed by hand.
